name: novarc
description: NOVARC skills for client teams: novarc-session-brainstorm (plan a feature into a planning artifact with faithful simulators), novarc-session-plan (turn the artifact into specs and sets in the repo), novarc-session-build (build one set of specs), novarc-session-end (close the branch and report back to the artifact) and novarc-codex-review (adversarial plan review).
